description: Books one open time for a buyer consultation or a listing appointment with the chosen brokerage. Needs the start of an open time, a first name, a phone or an email, and person_confirmed. Showings are not offered.

brokerage_id.description: A brokerage id, as listed by the brokerage search.

email.description: Give a phone or an email.

kind.description: buyer_consult: the person wants to buy a home. listing_appt: the person wants to sell their home.

note.description: What they want, in their words (area, timing, the home).

person_confirmed.description: true when the person agreed to this time and these details.

phone.description: A US phone number. Give a phone or an email.

start.description: The start of an open time, exactly as listed.

name: book_time
title: Book a time
